title: Release supply-chain gate
description: Objective: build reproducible supported packages, lockfile integrity, signed manifests, SBOMs, vulnerability/license reports, and doctor compatibility evidence. Deliverable: release packaging pipeline at one source commit. NOT in scope: publishing a release before all gates pass. Hard dependencies: Distribution manifest packaging and supported OS conformance. Owned paths: release tooling, packaging configs, and release evidence paths. Verification: pnpm test:integration plus reproducible packaging command.
definitionOfDone: Fresh frozen-lockfile builds succeed on every supported OS with pinned engine/tool versions.
Repeated builds verify manifests/assets and record any intentionally non-reproducible platform bytes honestly.
SBOM, dependency, license, signature, and compatibility evidence binds the exact commit.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.

Every refusal pins the stable code plus refusing layer (and delegated DISTRIBUTION_MISMATCH reason/refusedBy); generated sweeps assert positive case counts; refusal leaves the durable evidence destination byte-identical.

implementationPlan.description: Implement scripts/release/supply-chain.mjs as the Windows-only release orchestrator/CLI, keeping it separate from subject authority and under the per-file cap. Parse an exact bounded CLI/env shape; resolve one reachable HEAD source SHA and Git object format; create two isolated OS-temp source trees from git archive (no worktree); run a fresh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in each; invoke the production release-subject builder twice with one in-memory ephemeral Ed25519 key; and require byte-for-byte equality for every distribution container, manifest, and asset set. implementationPlan.note:
GATE GREEN. `pnpm verify:release` foreground, unpiped, EXIT=0 at frozen SHA 6daa942d2e547231d69b5eac0d00fa8bfb8b789c. Legs: typecheck:release 0; typecheck:packaging 0; vitest tests/integration 2 files / 40 tests; node --test release suite 41 tests / 41 pass / 0 fail INCLUDING "records truthful evidence through the actual package script" (17.6s) — the case amend-1 deferred here; then the real twice-built CLI.

THE FIRST RUN OF THIS GATE FAILED AND EXPOSED THREE REAL DEFECTS. None was reachable from the injected-port tests; all three needed the actual CLI.
1. SBOM_REPORT_INVALID, deterministic. `cdxgen -o -` is NOT a stdout selector — cdxgen printed a SECURE MODE table to stdout and wrote the document to bom.json, so JSON.parse(stdout) could never succeed. The SBOM leg had never once worked. Fixed by passing an explicit -o path under the throwaway source root and reading it back; a missing file is now a coded failure, not an empty parse. Port contract unchanged, so every existing fake-port case still applies.
2. REPRODUCIBILITY_MISMATCH. The BOM embeds the absolute path of the tree it scanned, and the two builds necessarily scan different temp roots, so normalized digests could never match. Fixed by rewriting THAT BUILD'S OWN source root — and only it — to <SOURCE_ROOT>, in both separator forms.
3. REPRODUCIBILITY_MISMATCH again. Measured two SBOMs from one unchanged tree: identical except /annotations/timestamp, a SECOND generation time cdxgen stamps beside the tool identity. Added that exact pointer to the reviewed volatile set; the cdxgen identity beside it still compares.
Both rewrites are DISCLOSED IN THE RECORD (normalizedPointers + normalizedSourceRootToken), never silent. Narrowness pinned in both directions: a path outside the build root, and annotation text drift other than the timestamp, still refuse REPRODUCIBILITY_MISMATCH.

STEP 6 REPEATED IN FULL after each fix, as its text requires.
